primary_population_source.name: Tranco Research-Grade Top 1M Sites List
primary_population_source.provider: TU Delft & Université Côte d'Azur (Victor Le Pochat, Tom Van Goethem, Samaneh Tajalizadehkhoob, Maciej Korczyński, Wouter Joosen)
primary_population_source.citation: Tranco: A Research-Oriented Top Sites Ranking Hardened Against Manipulation (NDSS 2019)
primary_population_source.permitted_use: Academic, research, measurement and benchmarking datasets with attribution.
primary_population_source.role: Authoritative population of globally ranked, active, non-manipulated registrable domains.

measurement_engine.methodology: Passive, non-intrusive network observation adhering to ethical internet measurement practices.

network_probes.description: Standard recursive lookup for A, AAAA, CNAME, and CAA records.
Safe cryptographic handshake negotiation to inspect cipher suite, TLS version, and leaf X.509 certificate.

network_probes.protocol: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 GET/HEAD on Ports 80 and 443
network_probes.description: Non-intrusive HTTP request to observe response status, redirect chain, headers, and cookie attributes.

ethical_and_safety_constraints: No invasive vulnerability scanning or injection testing.
Strict exclusion of authentication bypass or credential submission.
Strict prohibition against collecting or storing raw cookie values, session tokens, or personal identifiers.
Polite concurrency rates with per-target timeouts (3.0-5.0s) and standard User-Agent identification.
Zero modification of remote server state.

standards_and_taxonomies.name: Mozilla CCADB Root Store
standards_and_taxonomies.purpose: Validation of public trust anchors for leaf TLS certificates.

standards_and_taxonomies.name: OWASP Secure Headers Project
standards_and_taxonomies.purpose: Baseline directives and evaluation rules for modern HTTP response security headers.

standards_and_taxonomies.name: RFC 6797 (HSTS)
standards_and_taxonomies.purpose: Strict-Transport-Security evaluation rules and max-age thresholds.

standards_and_taxonomies.name: RFC 6265bis (Cookies)
standards_and_taxonomies.purpose: Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookie attribute security specifications.

standards_and_taxonomies.name: W3C Content Security Policy Level 3
standards_and_taxonomies.purpose: Content-Security-Policy evaluation and unsafe directive detection.
